title: 第1195章 给你机会了你不中用第1194章 林老魔哄骗女人有一手
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
叶倾仙心中情绪翻涌。
或许正是因为早已做出了决定。
也或许是认为这是最后的相处，她变得很是放肆。
她看着林云，红唇微微张开，呼出带着酒味的香气。
“那你是不是还喜欢我骂你。”她眼神之中有些林云害怕的韵味。
林老魔也是有些紧张了起来。
自己要是承认，那岂不是承认自己喜欢受虐啊。
那是万万不可的。
“如果是你的话，打是亲骂是爱，有什么不可以的。”
他抱紧了她的腰肢。
“哼，你就是个厚颜无耻的好色之徒，还不放开我！”
“还看，信不信我现在就挖出你的眼睛。”
叶倾仙忽然仰着脖颈冷漠的看着林云。
林云看着她，也是不由得一怔，不是，大小姐你来真的啊。
看着发呆的林云，叶倾仙却是噗嗤一笑，美艳不可方物。
“就是这样么？”
她笑盈盈的看着林老魔，身子也是微微扭了扭。
这种极致的反差。
让林老魔也是差点把持不住。
“你别闹，我们还在谈正事呢。”林云也是有些服气了。

这女人的心思他猜不透。
所以也不知道她到底在想什么。
但是有一点很确定，她心里有事情，这就够了。
“谈什么正事？”
“谈情说爱就不是正式么？”
叶倾仙从林云怀中坐起来。
她继续喝下一口美酒，然后眼眸水汪汪的看着他。
林老魔犹豫了一下，似乎明白了她的意思。
旋即喉结滚动，他低头下去。
.......
良久之后，两人都是长长的吸了口气。
互相对视一眼，一切尽在不言中。
到了这种地步，两人之间的那一层窗户纸也是彻底的被捅破了。
“是不是你爹要让你做出什么你不喜欢的事情？”
在这美好的旖旎时刻。
林老魔却是有些不解风情了起来，说出了这种话。
但是这也正是他责任感和爱意的体现。
content_en:
Ye Qingxian's heart was filled with emotions.
Perhaps it was because the decision had already been made.
Or perhaps because she thought this was the last time we would get along, she became very presumptuous.
She looked at Lin Yun, her red lips slightly opened, and she breathed out the aroma of wine.
"Then do you still like me scolding you?" There was a hint of Lin Yun's fear in her eyes.
Old Demon Lin also became a little nervous.
If he admitted it, wouldn't he be admitting that he likes to be abused?
That is absolutely impossible.
"If it's you, there's nothing wrong with hitting, scolding or loving."
He hugged her waist tightly.
"Hmph, you are a shameless womanizer, and you still won't let me go!"
"Look, believe it or not, I will dig out your eyes right now."
Ye Qingxian suddenly raised her neck and looked at Lin Yun indifferently.
Lin Yun looked at her and couldn't help but be startled, "No, Miss, are you serious?"
Looking at Lin Yun in a daze, Ye Qingxian smiled, extremely beautiful.
"Is that it?"
She looked at Old Mo Lin with a smile and twisted her body slightly.
Such an extreme contrast.
Old Demon Lin almost couldn't control himself.
"Don't make trouble, we are still talking about business." Lin Yun was also a little convinced.
He couldn't guess what this woman was thinking.
So I don't know what she is thinking.
But one thing is for sure, she has something on her mind, and that's enough.
"What are we talking about?"
"Isn't it formal to talk about love?"
Ye Qingxian sat up from Lin Yun's arms.
She continued to take a sip of the wine, and then looked at him with watery eyes.
Lin Laomo hesitated for a moment and seemed to understand what she meant.
Immediately his Adam's apple rolled and he lowered his head.
.......
After a long time, both of them took a long breath.
Looking at each other, nothing was said.
At this point, the layer of window paper between the two was completely broken.
"Is your father trying to make you do something you don't like?"
In this beautiful and charming moment.
However, Old Demon Lin became a little puzzled when he said such words.
But this is also the embodiment of his sense of responsibility and love.
